transcript:
Speaker A (Manager): What is this, Rakesh? You always give excuses. Either complete the work today or you can sign off from your job.
Speaker B (Rakesh): Sorry sir, I will complete it before I sign off this evening.
Speaker C (Maid): Thambi, your manager told you to finish the work or leave the job.
Speaker B: What? I thought he meant sign off for the day! How did you understand his English?
Speaker C: I learned through the SpeakX app. It's an AI-based English speaking app where you can practice daily in your regional language. It improves fluency in two weeks.
Speaker B: Is it expensive?
Speaker C: No, SpeakX offers a 7-day trial for just Rs. 2.
Speaker B: I'm downloading it now!
Speaker C: Download SpeakX today to improve your English.
on_screen_text: English subtitles corresponding to the dialogue. End card: SpeakX - Key to Confidence. Install Now. Google Play / App Store.
summary: A young man misunderstands his manager's English warning about losing his job, thinking it just meant signing off for the day. His housemaid, who learns English using the SpeakX app, corrects his misunderstanding and explains how the app offers daily AI practice for just Rs. 2 for a 7-day trial.
